node.title: Preestandarización
node.summary: Contribute cases, requirements or problems for standards discussion.

relations: A bounded, rights-cleared interoperability case could support a technical contribution without presenting the entire client engagement as a standards submission.
No es una contribución ya enviada, aceptada ni adoptada por un organismo de estándares.
The extensible case-study method could translate a frontier observation into a bounded requirement and test, rather than treating experience itself as a standard.
Propuesta de elaboración. Participación, entrega y publicación no acreditan adopción o respaldo de un organismo.
